propositions: On platforms without /proc (macOS), _process_start_time always returns None, making the recycled-pid discriminant unsatisfiable and causing dead processes with recycled pids to be judged fresh indefinitely
When a holder is dead but its pid number is recycled by an unrelated live process, _pid_alive reports live and the lock is judged fresh without start-time verification, creating an unbounded wedge

The fix applies _mkdir_lock_age_exceeds_ceiling on the live-pid branch only when current_start is unavailable, bounding the wedge to 1 hour while preserving the guarantee that genuinely live owners are never reclaimed on a timer alone
The module split extracts the owner-identity/stamp/staleness/reclaim cluster from lock.py (798 LOC) to lock_owner.py to stay within the 200-800 LOC per-file limit without using a re-export shim
